components.name: Save Button
components.description: The primary action that saves the buffered clip.
components.css: .ds-save { display: inline-flex; min-height: 39px; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; padding: 0 13px; border: 1px solid var(--orange-dark); border-radius: 3px; background: var(--orange); color: #fff; font: 700 11px 'Segoe UI Variable', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background .15s, border-color .15s, transform .15s; } .ds-save svg { width: 16px; height: 16px; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 1.7; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; } .ds-save kbd { padding: 4px 5px; border: 1px solid rgb(255 255 255 / 33%); border-radius: 2px; color: #fff4ef; font: 9px 'DM Mono', 'Consolas', monospace; } .ds-save:hover { transform: translateY(-1px); border-color: var(--orange-dark); background: var(--orange-dark); } .ds-save:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #718be9; outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-save:active { transform: translateY(0); }

components.name: Source Button
components.description: A restrained secondary action for choosing or stopping a capture source.
components.css: .ds-source { display: inline-flex; min-height: 38px; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; padding: 0 12px; border: 1px solid #ccd1ce; border-radius: 3px; background: #f7f8f5; color: #445261; font: 700 10px 'Segoe UI Variable', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background .15s, border-color .15s, transform .15s; } .ds-source svg { width: 15px; height: 15px; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 1.7; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; } .ds-source:hover { border-color: #8698d8; background: #edf0fb; } .ds-source:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #718be9; outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-source:active { transform: translateY(1px); }

components.name: Settings Field
components.description: A compact settings value field with a quiet surface and monospaced content.
components.css: .ds-field { display: block; color: #4c5968; font: 700 10px 'Segoe UI Variable', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; } .ds-field span { display: block; margin-bottom: 7px; } .ds-field input { width: 100%; min-height: 40px; padding: 0 11px; border: 1px solid #cfd5d1; border-radius: 3px; background: #fafbf8; color: var(--ink); font: 11px 'DM Mono', 'Consolas', monospace; } .ds-field input::placeholder { color: #a0a9a6; } .ds-field input:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #718be9; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Active Navigation Item
components.description: Selected rail navigation with a pale blue state and compact index.
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; min-height: 44px; align-items: center; gap: 12px; width: 100%; padding: 0 11px; border: 0; border-radius: 4px; background: #dce2f3; color: #293f9d; text-align: left; font: 600 12px 'Segoe UI Variable', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-nav svg { width: 17px; height: 17px; fill: none; stroke: var(--blue); stroke-width: 1.7; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; } .ds-nav span { flex: 1; } .ds-nav kbd { color: #929aa0; font: 10px 'DM Mono', 'Consolas', monospace; } .ds-nav:hover { background: #d3daf0; } .ds-nav:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #718be9; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.css: .ds-bench { min-width: 0; border: 1px solid #d5d9d6; background: #fafaf7; color: var(--ink); } .ds-bench header { display: flex; min-height: 50px; align-items: center; gap: 10px; padding: 0 17px; border-bottom: 1px solid #e0e3df; } .ds-bench header b { display: grid; width: 23px; height: 23px; place-items: center; background: #e4e8f4; color: var(--blue); font: 11px 'DM Mono', 'Consolas', monospace; } .ds-bench header strong { font: 700 12px 'Segoe UI Variable', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; } .ds-bench header small { margin-left: auto; color: #a2a9a5; font: 9px 'DM Mono', 'Consolas', monospace; } .ds-bench-body { display: grid; min-height: 80px; place-items: center; background: #202d45; color: #fff; font: 600 14px 'Segoe UI Variable', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; } .ds-bench footer { padding: 13px 17px; border-top: 1px solid #e0e3df; color: var(--muted); font: 10px 'Segoe UI Variable', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; }

components.name: Capture Status Chip
components.description: An outlined status label that distinguishes waiting from active capture.
components.css: .ds-status { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 8px 10px; border: 1px solid #e6c6bd; border-radius: 3px; color: #a84b31; font: 500 9px 'DM Mono', 'Consolas', monospace; letter-spacing: .055em; } .ds-status i { width: 7px; height: 7px; flex: 0 0 auto; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--orange); animation: ds-pulse 1.6s ease-in-out infinite; } @keyframes ds-pulse { 50% { box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px rgb(221 96 62 / 13%); } }

components.css: .ds-rewind { display: flex; min-height: 190px; flex-direction: column; padding: 17px; border: 1px solid #d5d9d6; background: #eceee9; color: var(--ink); } .ds-rewind-head,.ds-rewind-head small,.ds-markers,.ds-foot { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; } .ds-rewind-head { gap: 8px; color: #737f87; font: 500 9px 'DM Mono', 'Consolas', monospace; letter-spacing: .09em; } .ds-rewind-head small { gap: 6px; color: #909995; font: 9px 'DM Mono', 'Consolas', monospace; letter-spacing: 0; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-rewind-head i { width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--orange); } .ds-readout { margin-top: 25px; } .ds-readout strong { font: 500 37px 'DM Mono', 'Consolas', monospace; letter-spacing: -.08em; } .ds-readout span { color: #919a98; font: 12px 'DM Mono', 'Consolas', monospace; } .ds-markers,.ds-foot { color: #8e9795; font: 8px 'DM Mono', 'Consolas', monospace; } .ds-markers { margin: 22px 0 9px; } .ds-track { position: relative; height: 29px; border: 1px solid #cbd0cb; background: #f6f7f3; } .ds-fill { position: absolute; inset: 0 40% 0 0; background: #d7e1d8; } .ds-ticks { position: absolute; inset: 0; background: repeating-linear-gradient(90deg, transparent 0 calc(2.08% - 1px), #c5ccc7 calc(2.08% - 1px) 2.08%); } .ds-playhead { position: absolute; top: -5px; bottom: -5px; left: 60%; width: 2px; background: var(--orange); } .ds-foot { margin-top: 9px; color: #8b9592; font-size: 9px; }

narrative.overview:
Velex Clip's default interface is a dark graphite capture station with cyan and indigo brand facets, blue wayfinding, and a restrained orange save signal. A paper-light theme is available as an alternative. The ruled rewind track, elapsed-time readout, source viewfinder, and save action keep capture state legible before a clip becomes a library item.

The capture workspace gives the live source and rewind instrument priority. The library, editing, optional user-configured cloud setup, and update controls use the same compact tool-interface language. Browser capture is permissioned and page-scoped; the Windows desktop mode adds a native source picker, global shortcut, and system tray.
keyCharacteristics: Instrument-first capture bench, not a gallery-first dashboard.
Dark graphite default with cyan/indigo branding, blue wayfinding, and an optional paper-light theme.
Fine rules, compact monospaced instrument labels, and mostly flat rectangular panels.

rules.name: The Signal Discipline Rule
rules.body: Reserve orange for the save/capture signal and its closely related live-state indicators; use blue for selection and navigation, not as a competing save action.

rules.name: The Instrument Label Rule
rules.body: Keep time values, shortcuts, serials, and compact control labels in the monospaced stack; use the system sans for sentences and headings.

rules.name: The Flat Bench Rule
rules.body: Do not add ambient shadows to the resting capture panels; use the existing tonal surface steps and fine borders to establish structure.

dos: Do keep the source view, rewind ruler, duration control, and save action together in the capture bench.
Do use the orange signal for capture/save and blue for selection and wayfinding.
Do use fine rules and tonal surfaces before introducing depth.
Do preserve Turkish interface copy and the browser permission/page-focus limitations in any capture-state guidance.
Do keep local clip review and trimming visually coherent with the capture workbench.
donts: Don't replace the capture-first workspace with a gallery-first dashboard.
Don't spread orange across large surfaces or use it as a decorative accent.
Don't imply background recording or a global shortcut in browser mode; those behaviors are available only in the Windows desktop app.
Don't imply cloud storage is ready by default; users configure their own provider credentials.
Don't embed shared cloud credentials or server secrets in client code.
Don't use shadows on ordinary resting panels or round every edge into a pill.
